🚨 First HMPV Case Reported in India 🇮🇳👶
An 8-year-old in Bengaluru has tested positive for Human MetaPneumoVirus (HMPV), marking the first reported case in India. No travel history is reported. Here's what you need to know: 🧵 #HMPV #India
